reports.title: Guardant Health Reports Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results and Increases 2026 Revenue Guidance

guidance.heading: 2026 Guidance
section: Guardant Health now expects full year 2026 revenue to be in the range of $1.36 to $1.37 billion, representing growth of 38% to 40% compared to full year 2025. This compares to the prior range of $1.34 to $1.36 billion, representing growth of 36% to 38%.
